component.name: LinkShot
component.summary: Screenshots, scrolling capture, screen recording and an image editor

description.p: LinkShot captures regions, windows, full screens and whole scrolling pages at native resolution, records the screen to animated GIF or MP4, extracts text from images, and edits captures with arrows, callouts, shapes, text, highlights, blur, steps, effects and more.

Recordings include the microphone and system audio, an optional webcam overlay and Screen Draw annotations; the Editor keeps annotations as editable objects, saves .snagx files and exports PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, ICO and MP4. Print Screen can start a capture system-wide, and scrolling captures stitch whole pages pixel-exactly even with sticky headers.

Everything needed is included: video export and text recognition work out of the box. LinkShot is a free, open-source alternative to Snagit, Flameshot, Spectacle, ShareX and Greenshot for KDE Plasma, GNOME and other Wayland or X11 desktops, and for Windows.
